note: Re-judged at HEAD against RFC 4271 Section 6.3 as updated by RFC 7606 Section 7.1 (malformed/undefined ORIGIN SHALL use treat-as-withdraw). TestSessionRFC4271RevisedAttributeErrors drives an established eBGP Session over net.Pipe in a good/bad/good sequence: positive sends isolated ORIGIN value 3 (length 1, flags 0x40, valid AS_PATH/NEXT_HOP/NLRI) and asserts exact withdrawal payload makeUpdateBody(prefix, nil, nil) without resetting the session; negative sends valid ORIGIN IGP (0) before and after on the same Session and asserts the prefix is delivered in NLRI.
